name: Elements | Modiano Red 1 1/4
description:
Elements Red 1 1/4 Size Hemp Rolling Paper is the perfect rolling paper for those looking to get a slow, even burn. Made with natural unbleached hemp paper and featuring Elements' patented criss-cross watermark, these papers are sure to give you an excellent smoking experience every time. They come in packs of 50 sheets, so you're always stocked up on your favorite rolling papers.

Elements Red 1 1/4 Size Hemp Rolling Paper is ideal for denser, moister legal herbs and will ensure that you enjoy a smooth smoke all day long. So what are you waiting for?
